issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named `_detect_errors(measurements, checks)`, but both the template and the reference solution define the function as `detect_errors(measurements, checks)` (no leading underscore). This naming mismatch between the written task and the provided code will confuse students about which function name to implement and which name the autograder/tests will call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the problem statement to request `detect_errors(measurements: npt.NDArray[np.int8], checks: npt.NDArray[np.int8]) -> npt.NDArray[np.int8]` (no leading underscore) so it matches the template and solution. Alternatively, rename the function in the template and solution to `_detect_errors(...)` and update any tests to call that name. Ensure tests and examples use the same name.
